history.summary: IDENTITY UNCERTAIN - verify before use. The only web evidence found for an ISKCON temple in Sangareddy district is a YouTube promo video ('Kambalpalli ISKCON Temple | Sri Jagannath Swamy', Prabha Samrat channel, ~Sept 2026) describing an ISKCON temple dedicated to Sri Jagannath Swamy at Kambalpalli village, Sadasivpet mandal, Sangareddy district, with a gaushala and farmland setting. No official ISKCON directory listing, no address, no founding details and no independent corroboration were found. The CSV town 'Sangareddy' is imprecise at best - the sole candidate referent is at KAMBALPALLI village (Sadasivpet mandal), not Sangareddy town; coordinates below are the village centroid, not the temple's own verified location. If the CSV intends a different ISKCON centre (e.g. Hyderabad's ISKCON Kukatpally, ~38 km away), that should be established. Treat this file as a placeholder pending verification.

name: Kambalpalli ISKCON Temple (Sri Jagannath Swamy)
town_description: Kambalpalli is a small village in Sadasivpet mandal, Sangareddy district, Telangana (census village code 573838, population ~1,095), about 7 km from Sadasivpet town and 25 km from the district headquarters Sangareddy. It sits amid farmland (cotton, paddy, turmeric).

travel.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad, roughly 65-70 km via Sadasivpet (verify).
travel.road: Kambalpalli village is about 7 km from Sadasivpet town on local roads.
